governs.description: Which PLANE this layer governs. assistant_workflow = the AI/CI workflow that BUILDS this repo (agents, their models, their tools). product_runtime = the shipped product's own behaviour. The two are separate: an assistant-plane model id sent to the product's provider fails every call and surfaces as a bad key, not a bad model. policy-ci asserts the separation.

require_golden_per_bug.description: R-4. When true, harness doctor FAILS if a bug logged in buglist.md has no golden case referencing it (a case whose `bug` field names the bug id). Default false: a check that turns every existing project red the day it ships is the cry-wolf failure C14 forbids, so a project opts in once it has caught up.

require_pipeline_record_for_release.description: When true, the PDP release gate (deploy/rollback_deploy) FAILS unless a PipelineRun was logged for the exact commit being released (head_ref matched against the hook's own `git rev-parse HEAD`). Closes the gap where RECORD is a prompted SKILL.md step, not a hook, so 'ran the pipeline but forgot to log it' looks identical to '0 runs'. Default false, same reasoning as require_golden_per_bug: every project starts with zero PipelineRun history, so shipping this ON turns every release red on day one -- the cry-wolf failure C14 forbids. Opt in per project once its release workflow actually logs pipeline runs.

buglist_path.description: R-4. Where the bug log lives, if not the default buglist.md at the project root. Read from config rather than hardcoded so a project that keeps it elsewhere is not silently reported as having no bugs (C2).

golden_exempt_bugs.description: R-4. Bug ids that cannot be expressed as a golden case, mapped to the REASON. This harness's golden runner evaluates one thing: whether an input string is denied by the guard policy. A parser bug, an encoding bug or an ingest 422 has no such input, so demanding a golden case for it would be demanding something the runner cannot represent -- and the usual result is a fake case written to clear a check. doctor can verify an exemption is DECLARED; it cannot verify the reason is true or that a regression test exists (C12).
